title: Financial Numerical Recipes in C++
subtitle: Applications in Finance
author: Bernt Arne Ødegaard
description: A collection of C++ implementations of common quantitative-finance calculations: present value and term structures, option pricing (Black-Scholes, binomial, finite-difference, Monte Carlo), bonds, mean-variance portfolios, and more.

license.name: Made freely available by the author
license.note: The author distributes the book for free from his university page but states no explicit redistribution license, so TLP links to the official copy only. A maintainer could contact the author to confirm terms.
